community is not reviewing the patch, seems like this patch is not needed.
I really appreciate unit tests, lets make sure we're following the coding standard when we do it.
Add 'test' to the filename like the other testcases?
Done

1. we're trying to reduce the use of boost flat map and replace with std
2. You didn't include the boost flat map header here.
3. This isn't really a "test" type.  Ideally for dbus types we should be parsing using the same methods in tests and functional code.

Fixed 1,2, and added another patch to the series to remove the last usage of the boost flat map.

For 3, EM does not query it's own DBus interface, so it does not have such a type.

It has `DBusInterface` and `DBusValue` types declared in `src/utils.hpp` but that does not have every type in there which i need.

So rather than risking to break some code by messing with that variant, i declare one here for local use.

> does not have every type in there which i need.

So, add the types?  FWIW, keeping a single variable with "all possible" unpack types is what bmcweb transitioned to a few years ago, and it simplified a lot of APIs, and dropped the compile times a bunch.  method_call templates are very heavy to compile, and having multiple "property" types causes a lot of duplicated code in the binary.

Added it to the existing variant to avoid duplication.

Also made another patch to fix the existing duplication of this variant.
pass error code by const reference please.
Done

No lambdas over a few lines.  Please grok this time and do not send new commits with errors you've already been asked to resolve before.  If you disagree with the coding guidelines, that's a discussion we can have on a suggested change to the coding standard, but sending new patches that break this rule when you know it is disheartening and makes me want to review your patches less.
Fixed it 👍
Thank you, appreciate it.
Why post here?
I can't remember exactly why i did that. Maybe it's required for a patch further up. Removed it here for now.
